opportunities.title: Small Grants – UK (September 2026 deadline)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. UK‑based organisations are eligible.
opportunities.summary: Seed‑funding to enable UK‑Japan collaborative projects across arts, culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine, health, science, youth, education and sport. Grants are typically £1,500‑£5,000, up to £6,000 in exceptional cases.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total for multi‑year projects

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be based in the UK or Japan and propose a collaborative project involving partners in both countries. Open to researchers, practitioners, policy makers, managers and voluntary sector workers in health‑related fields.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK. Grants up to £10,000 per year (maximum £30,000 for up to three years) to fund travel, conference, publication and related costs.
